sn35.114:1.1: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Paṭimukkassa Mārapāso baddho so Mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || pa ||
sn35.114:3.1: Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīya || || Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Paṭimukkassa Mārapāso baddho so Mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || || Santi
sn35.114:4.1: ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati
sn35.114:5.1: nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na āvāsagato Mārassa na Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Ummukkassa Mārapāso mutto so Mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || la ||
sn35.114:6.1: Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave na āvāsagato Mārassa na Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Ummukkassa Mārapāso mutto so Mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimatoti || ||
